svg.title: BeagleBoard-xM (TI DM3730), component side
svg.desc: Orthographic top view of the 85.1 × 85.6 mm BeagleBoard-xM. Copper, solder mask, silkscreen, drills and part positions are converted from the rev C1 design files by Gerald Coley of BeagleBoard.org (CC BY-SA 3.0); the parts, colours and finish are redrawn from photographs of production boards. Legends are outlines; LEDs are drawn unlit.
